top_signals.title: Disney Up on Adjusted EPS Beat; Home Depot Down on Guidance | Stock Movers
top_signals.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Disney (DIS) shares are rising after the media company reported adjusted earnings per share for the fourth quarter that beat the average analyst estimate.
- Home Depot (HD) shares are lower despite quarterly earnings beating estimates. It comes after the retailer adjusted its year guidance, which analysts say implies a deceleration for the fourth quarter. 
- Red Cat Holdings (RCAT) shares sliding after the company said it no longer expects to achieve its full-year revenue target and reported third-quarter results that missed the average analyst estimate on key metrics. (Source: Bloomberg)
